seal_policy.note: Manifest hashes CHECKSUMS.txt and receipt. Self-hashing is impossible; retain final manifest SHA-256 externally. Integrity seal, not authenticated signature.

limitations: Full-fit predictions and notebook plots are in-sample, provided for requested internal stacking; no OOF/holdout delivery prerequisite and no unbiased generalization claim.

Fresh original-video parity covers 20 existing historical fit fixtures with verified media hashes, not all 32000 original videos. Full32k regression replays generation-specific cached features. Four decoded tensors and six synthetic videos add deterministic coverage, not corpus-wide media validation.

No unseen-media FPR guarantee, exhaustive codec/backend/damaged-media matrix or independent clean-venv installation/version matrix was tested. Loader uses private joblib interfaces at pinned versions.
SHA-256 seals detect drift relative to a trusted manifest digest; they are not a digital signature or independent authenticity attestation.
